changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnostictestreporttemplate AS SELECT drt.id, drt.diagnostic_test_id, drt.name, drt.template_value, drt.is_active, drt.created_date, drt.created_by, drt.last_modified_by, drt.last_modified_date FROM public.diagnostic_test_report_template drt;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestreporttemplate TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestreporttemplate FROM report_user;
